response.sql: SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 as region, SUM(t.amount) as total_amount, COUNT(*) as transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans) as fraction FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
